title: Civil engineering draftsperson
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a civil drafter?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
How many years' experience do you have as a Civil Design Draftsperson?
rationale: Melbourne Doncaster East civil draftsperson with AutoCAD/stormwater/roads matches discipline and location.
Advanced Diploma requirement is met; at least 3 years as civil engineering draftsperson is not met (academic drafting only).
Mentoring less experienced drafters and unassisted drawing production imply commercial seniority.
gaps: At least 3 years experience as a Civil engineering draftsperson
mandatory_unmet: At least 3 years experience as a Civil engineering draftsperson
